> Technology partner specializing in scalable application development, cloud data engineering, business intelligence, and digital marketing systems.

---

## 1. Company Overview
CodePlaced is a modern technology partner helping businesses build scalable digital products, unlock commercial value from data, and accelerate growth through digital marketing. We deliver production-grade software, AI-powered automation, and executive dashboards with fixed milestone cadences (typically in 2-4 week sprints).

## 2. Core Service Offerings

### App & Web Development
- Mobile App Development: High-performance iOS and Android applications built with React Native and Flutter.
- Web & Custom Applications: Full-stack Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Java Spring Boot platforms.
- SaaS Development: Scalable multi-tenant architectures with role-based access control (RBAC) and payment gateways.
- E-Commerce & CMS: Custom Shopify, WordPress, headless storefronts, and third-party API integrations.
- Backend & DevOps: Resilient REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, containerization with Docker & Kubernetes.
- URL: https://codeplaced.com/services

### Data Engineering & Analytics
- Data Pipelines & ETL/ELT: Automated pipelines orchestrating raw streaming and batch datasets using Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, and Apache Airflow.
- Lakehouse & Warehousing: Medallion data architectures (Bronze/Silver/Gold) with row-level security and automated schema validation.
- Business Intelligence: High-density interactive executive command centers using Microsoft Power BI and Google Looker Studio.
- Predictive Analytics & KPI Telemetry: Live financial, supply chain, clinical, and customer analytics.
- URL: https://codeplaced.com/services

### Digital & Social Marketing
- Organic SEO & Technical Audits: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), structured Schema.org markup, and high-density technical content.
- Paid Advertising & Acquisition: High-converting multi-channel campaigns on Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
- Content Strategy & Social Growth: Brand storytelling, copywriting, graphic design, and short-form video content.
- Marketing Analytics & Attribution: Full-funnel tracking with GA4, server-side Tag Manager, and conversion API integrations.
- URL: https://codeplaced.com/services

## 4. Featured Case Studies
1. Real-Time Inventory & Order Sync (Retail & E-Commerce):
   - Outcome: 2.4M SKUs synchronized across 18 regional warehouses with <1.5s live response time and 99.99% system availability.
   - URL: https://codeplaced.com/case-studies/real-time-inventory-sync

2. Healthcare Clinical Analytics Platform (HealthTech):
   - Outcome: 450k+ active patient interactions monitored with 100% HIPAA compliance and 60% faster clinical reporting.
   - URL: https://codeplaced.com/case-studies/healthcare-analytics-platform

3. AI Workflow & Financial Ledger Reconciliation (FinTech):
   - Outcome: $42M+ in daily transaction volume processed with 99.98% automated reconciliation accuracy.
   - URL: https://codeplaced.com/case-studies/ai-workflow-financial-ledger
